Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing possession of electronic weapons on school property.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the possession of electronic weapons on schoolproperty; adding a new section to chapter 9.41 RCW; and prescribingpenalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is unlawful for a minor under the age of eighteen or astudent of a public or private elementary or secondary school to carryonto, or to possess on, public or private elementary or secondaryschool premises, school provided transportation, or areas of facilitieswhile being used exclusively by public or private schools anyelectronic weapon as defined in subsection (3) of this section. (2) A person who violates this section is guilty of a grossmisdemeanor. (3) For the purposes of this section, "electronic weapon" means anelectronic device that emits an electrical charge and that is designedand primarily employed to incapacitate a person or animal eitherthrough contact with electrodes on the device itself, remotely through p. 1 HB 1764wired probes that are attached to the device, or through a spark,plasma, ionization, or other conductive means emitting from the device.
